detailed_description:
The target video uses a warm, intimate hand-held showcase aesthetic with soft indoor lighting, matching <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] A close-up to medium shot establishes a hand holding <Subject 1>, the pink plush rabbit referenced from <Picture 1>, at chest level against a white wooden door decorated with cartoon rabbit and bear cutouts and a small dangling figure. <Subject 1> has closed eyes with red stitched eyebrows, a small pink smile on a white muzzle, blushing pink cheeks, a small red bow tie at the neck, a cream belly patch with a small stitched "x", and two long light-blue ribbon tears hanging down from the closed eyes. The long floppy ears frame either side of the head, with a yellow checkered inner lining visible along their length. The hand adjusts its grip and presents the rabbit to the lens, with the girl's long dark hair visible on the right edge of the frame. The camera holds a near-static shot with a gentle natural sway from the hand.
[Shot 2] At 00:06.500, the camera cuts to a slightly wider shot from a higher angle. The girl, wearing light-pink Hello Kitty-patterned loungewear, stands barefoot on a wooden floor with a Hello Kitty mat visible at the bottom of the frame and the decorated white door behind her. She holds <Subject 1> at waist level, presenting the full body of the pink plush rabbit. The cream belly patch, both feet, and the full length of the long ears with their yellow checkered inner lining are visible. The back view from the right side of <Picture 1> is referenced in the soft contour of the body, with a small white cotton tail implied at the lower back. The camera holds a near-static shot with gentle sway as the girl displays the rabbit.
